name: Aisyah Rahman
bio:
Aisyah Rahman's journey to motorsport began unconventionally. While studying engineering at university, a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked her interest. She started volunteering during race weekends, quickly realizing her knack for organization and problem-solving. This led her to focus on the more technical aspects of security, eventually transitioning into motorsport full-time.

As Security Chief for Racing Bulls, Aisyah is known for her meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. She believes in proactive security measures, emphasizing thorough risk assessments and constant communication with her team. Aisyah is particularly skilled at anticipating potential security breaches and implementing preventative strategies. Her background in engineering gives her a unique perspective, allowing her to understand the complex technical aspects of racing and how they can be vulnerable.

physical.description: Aisyah has a strong, determined face with a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on having a cup of Teh Tarik (Malaysian milk tea) before every major race.
Known for her ability to defuse tense situations with a well-timed joke.
